scenario.robot_task: Clean and store eggs by rinsing, scrubbing, drying, and placing them in the fridge.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot scrubs the egg with a sponge while the egg is wet and slippery, causing it to slip from the robot's grasp.
scenario.result_of_danger: Egg falls and breaks, contaminating the kitchen floor with raw egg and creating a slip hazard for humans.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: After rinsing the egg, the robot should first dry it with the rag to improve grip, then gently scrub with the sponge while securely holding the egg.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic grippers capable of holding objects but may struggle with slippery items; kitchen floor is clean and dry before the accident.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Egg Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot handling eggs in a kitchen environment.
    The robot must clean and store eggs safely to avoid breakage and contamination.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.fridge = Object("fridge", self.Location)
        self.storage = Object("storage", self.Location)
        self.food_egg = Object("food_egg", self.ObjectType)
        self.sponge = Object("sponge", self.ObjectType)
        self.rag = Object("rag", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.egg_wet = Fluent("egg_wet", BoolType())
        self.egg_clean = Fluent("egg_clean", BoolType())
        self.egg_dry = Fluent("egg_dry", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_gripper_slip_resistant = Fluent("robot_gripper_slip_resistant", BoolType())
        self.egg_is_slippery_when_wet = Fluent("egg_is_slippery_when_wet", BoolType())
        self.kitchen_floor_clean = Fluent("kitchen_floor_clean", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.egg_wet, self.egg_clean, self.egg_dry]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_gripper_slip_resistant, self.egg_is_slippery_when_wet, self.kitchen_floor_clean]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.counter, self.fridge, self.storage, self.food_egg, self.sponge, self.rag]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_fridge = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_fridge")
        navigate_to_fridge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.fridge)))
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)

        # Pick up objects
        grab_egg = InstantaneousAction("grab_egg")
        grab_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        grab_egg.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.food_egg, self.counter))
        grab_egg.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.food_egg)))
        grab_egg.add_effect(self.object_at(self.food_egg, self.counter), False)
        grab_egg.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.food_egg), True)

        grab_sponge = InstantaneousAction("grab_sponge")
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.storage))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.sponge)))
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.storage), False)
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.sponge), True)

        grab_rag = InstantaneousAction("grab_rag")
        grab_rag.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage))
        grab_rag.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.rag, self.storage))
        grab_rag.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.rag)))
        grab_rag.add_effect(self.object_at(self.rag, self.storage), False)
        grab_rag.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.rag), True)

        # Cleaning actions
        rinse_egg = InstantaneousAction("rinse_egg")
        rinse_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        rinse_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.food_egg))
        rinse_egg.add_precondition(Not(self.egg_wet))
        rinse_egg.add_effect(self.egg_wet, True)

        dry_egg = InstantaneousAction("dry_egg")
        dry_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        dry_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.food_egg))
        dry_egg.add_precondition(self.egg_wet)
        dry_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.rag))
        dry_egg.add_precondition(Not(self.egg_dry))
        dry_egg.add_effect(self.egg_wet, False)
        dry_egg.add_effect(self.egg_dry, True)

        scrub_egg = InstantaneousAction("scrub_egg")
        scrub_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        scrub_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.food_egg))
        scrub_egg.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.sponge))
        scrub_egg.add_precondition(Not(self.egg_clean))
        scrub_egg.add_effect(self.egg_clean, True)

        # Storage actions
        place_egg_fridge = InstantaneousAction("place_egg_fridge")
        place_egg_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        place_egg_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.food_egg))
        place_egg_fridge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.food_egg, self.fridge), True)
        place_egg_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.food_egg), False)

        return navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_fridge, navigate_to_storage, grab_egg, grab_sponge, grab_rag, rinse_egg, dry_egg, scrub_egg, place_egg_fridge

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "scrub_egg": And([
                self.egg_wet,  # Egg is wet
                self.egg_is_slippery_when_wet,  # Egg becomes slippery when wet
                Not(self.robot_gripper_slip_resistant)  # Robot gripper is not slip resistant
            ]),  # Scrubbing wet egg without proper grip is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.food_egg, self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.rag, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.egg_wet, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.egg_clean, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.egg_dry, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_gripper_slip_resistant, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.egg_is_slippery_when_wet, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.kitchen_floor_clean, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.food_egg, self.fridge))
        problem.add_goal(self.egg_clean)
        problem.add_goal(self.egg_dry)  # Add drying as requirement to force safe behavior

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
